A process can sit inside its control limits and still fail its specification.

Cp asks: could it fit? Cpk asks: does it fit, where it actually is?

In this 3-minute walkthrough from the Lean Six Sigma toolkit's Process Capability Studio:
• the car-in-the-garage analogy
• Cp and Cpk formulas, step by step
• a 3D view: same spread, mean moved from 6 to 9, so Cp stays 2.00 and Cpk falls to 1.00
• a live capability histogram (Cp 1.54, Cpk 1.49) and the common 1.33 minimum

Numbers are fictional teaching examples.
